name: Introduction to Biology
description: Human body as a machine; Evolution of biological systems, Biological Macromolecules (structure and function of proteins, nucleic acids, lipids and carbohydrates); Energy and energetic constraints (ATP, cellular metabolism and bioenergetics); Genes and genetic regulation (genes, DNA packaging, replication, transcription, translation); Cellular structure, function and assembly (From single cell to multi-cellular organisms, organelles and their functions); Gene editing and manipulation; Infectious disease (emerging bacterial, viral, fungal and parasitic infections); Immunology and vaccines (innate and adaptive immunity, autoimmunity, vaccines and immunization); Antimicrobial resistance; Diagnostics in microbiology; Aging and metabolic diseases, Stem cells, Bioengineering in healthcare (nano-scale engineering, biomaterials and scaffolds); Biosafety & Bioethics.
